resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or any open-source plane-wave DFT code that supports LDA)

access.notes: The agent may use any open-source DFT code capable of LDA calculations (e.g., QE, GPAW, ABINIT) that can produce a density of states.

resources.name: LDA pseudopotentials for Re, Ge, As

access.notes: SSSP efficiency library (or PSlibrary) contains LDA pseudopotentials for these elements. The agent may also use other publicly available pseudopotential sets.

resources.name: Python scientific stack (ase, spglib, numpy, matplotlib)

access.notes: Install via pip. Useful for structure construction and analysis.
